legend: Sharply demarcated, compact proliferation of small, uniformly round and regular tubular structures. (H&E)
Mass-forming, sharply demarcated, compact proliferation of small, uniformly round and regular tubular structures.

Tubular adenoma consists of acini and tubules lined by a double layer of inner ductal luminal cells and an outer layer of attenuated myoepithelial cells. No nuclear atypia is present. The cells of the tubular adenoma (left side of image) are indistinguishable from the cells of adjacent normal terminal duct lobular units (right side of image).
A tubular adenoma with circumscribed borders and closely packed bilayered tubules separated by scant stroma.  Some tubules contain luminal pink secretions.
